cli.intro: nifty — gitmoji-first release tooling for hybrid cargo + npm workspaces
cli.cmd.check: Lint commit subjects and fail on errors
cli.cmd.upload: Upload generic assets to GitHub Release or GitHub Pages
cli.cmd.bump: Align workspace crate and package versions
cli.cmd.publish: Publish workspace npm packages (OIDC or token + TOTP)
cli.cmd.trust: Configure npm Trusted Publisher for workspace packages
cli.opt.from: Start git ref for commit range
cli.opt.to: End git ref for commit range
cli.opt.subject: Lint a single subject string (repeatable)
cli.opt.release: Upload files from --dir to the GitHub Release for --tag
cli.opt.both: GitHub Release upload and GitHub Pages deploy
cli.opt.name: GitHub Release title
cli.opt.dry-run: Print actions without writing or publishing
cli.opt.refresh: Ignore publish/trust cache and re-check registry
cli.opt.only: Limit trust to one package name
